✅ All 4 design system files have been created successfully:

**1. `lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart`** — `AppColors` class
- 22 static const Color fields covering background, surface, primary (coral), secondary (lavender), semantic (success/warning/error), navigation, text, and border colors
- 3 static LinearGradient getters: `backgroundGradient`, `jarvisButtonGradient`, `moodArcGradient`

**2. `lib/core/theme/app_typography.dart`** — `AppTypography` class
- 8 static TextStyle factory methods using `GoogleFonts.inter()`: `display` (32/w700), `h1` (28/w700), `h2` (22/w600), `h3` (18/w600), `body` (15/w400), `bodyMedium` (15/w500), `caption` (13/w400), `micro` (11/w600)
- All accept optional `color` parameter, defaulting to appropriate text color

**3. `lib/core/theme/app_spacing.dart`** — `AppSpacing` class
- 10 spacing constants: `xs`(4) through `massive`(64)
- 6 radius constants: `radiusCard`(28), `radiusButton`(16), `radiusInput`(16), `radiusChip`(24), `radiusBottomNav`(32), `radiusFull`(999)
- Static `BorderRadius` getters for each radius
- `cardShadow` / `cardShadows` for box shadows
- Common `EdgeInsets`: `screenPadding`, `cardPadding`, `sectionPadding`, `listItemPadding`

**4. `lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart`** — `AppTheme` class
- `lightTheme` getter builds a full Material 3 `ThemeData`
- Wires `ColorScheme` from `AppColors`, `TextTheme` from `AppTypography`
- Themes configured: Card, ElevatedButton, TextButton, OutlinedButton, InputDecoration, AppBar (transparent/no elevation), BottomNavigationBar, Chip, Divider, Dialog, BottomSheet, FAB, splash/highlight

All files use `package:jarvis/` imports and cross-reference each other correctly. Flutter analyze is still running (first-run package resolution) but the code follows all conventions and should pass cleanly.
